evidence.paragraph: For the three months ended September 30, 2026, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $75.1 million, or $0.41 per diluted share, compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $106.0 million, or $0.58 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025. Net Income in the third quarter of 2026 includes provisions for impairment of $65.1 million, or $0.35 per diluted share, and gains on sale of real estate of $23.8 million, or $0.13 per diluted share.
